newsitem.title: RUSSIA: ING-Bank names Russia's Uneximbank subdepositary.
newsitem.headline: ING-Bank names Russia's Uneximbank subdepositary.

text.p: ING-Bank has named Uneximbank its subdepositary on the Russian equities market, Uneximbank deputy chairman Mikhail Alexeyev said on Wednesday.
Uneximbank (Oneksimbank in Russian) will be able to hold Russian company shares purchased by ING-Bank clients and handle some other depositary activities.
Uneximbank plans to sign similar agreements with some other foreign banks, Alexeyev told Reuters.
Last month Uneximbank signed similar deals with the Bank of New York and the First National Bank of Boston.
